title: Lawn parties and fish fries by day of week
summary: Nothing special on weekdays; lawn parties were Sunday night and fish fries Saturday, with singing and clapping but no band.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I wondered if there was anything specially good on, say, Tuesday. How's that? Is Tuesday a good day for any kind of job, a Wednesday, a Thursday? No, not that I can recall, no, no. They wouldn't have dances on a Wednesday march, or?

No, not for the week, no, I mean, lawn parties, like they'd have lawn parties, well, that would always be on Sunday night. And, well, fish fries, you know, fish fries would always be on Saturday night, you see, you'd see the red lantern in there by the gate, you know, where you know that there was fine fishing. Back there, you'd go back in the alley and to the kitchen always lead you to the kitchen, you know, alley leads you to the kitchen. And everybody back there, sitting out eating fish, drinking the old wine, having a good time, you know. Those were really some good days.
What kind of band would they have in a fish?

None of them have no band. I mean, maybe a guy would have a show, have a guitar, they'd be singing or something like that. Oh, everybody would start singing and clapping and doing a number or something like that, be happy, you know. With no music?
They just clap and sing. No music. No, people don't clap.
